template.name: Consolidation Breakout
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high, {p0}) and ema(close, {p1}) > ema(close, {p2}) and bars_since(atr(high, low, close, 10) < {p0} * atr(high, low, close, 40)) < 5 and roc(close, 14) > {p1} and macd(close, 12, 26) > macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9)
template.notes: The two typical-price LWMAs are approximated by EMA(10)/EMA(30) on close, the overlapping-bar consolidation by a 10-vs-40 ATR squeeze inside the last five bars, the momentum-above-100 filter by ROC(14)>0, and the separate-timeframe MACD by MACD(12,26,9) on this series. Pip take-profit/stop-loss, TradeVolume, and the short side are not percentage/DSL fields.
